## Overview
### Introduction to Xiaomi: MiMo-V2-Omni
The Xiaomi: MiMo-V2-Omni model, provided by Xiaomi, is a standard-tier, non-open-source language model released on January 1, 2024. This model boasts a robust architecture capable of handling a wide range of tasks, including text generation, function calling, and structured outputs. With its extensive capabilities, the MiMo-V2-Omni is well-suited for applications such as chat, text generation, coding, analysis, and summarization.

### Technical Specifications and Pricing
From a technical standpoint, the MiMo-V2-Omni model has a context window of 262,144 tokens and can generate up to 65,536 tokens as output. The pricing for this model is as follows: $0.4 per 1M tokens for input, $2.0 per 1M tokens for output, with no charges for cached or batch input. The model's performance is benchmarked with an MMLU score of 80.0 and an LMSYS Arena ELO of 1200. Developers can expect to pay $1.2 for 1,000 calls (averaging 500 tokens), $12.0 for 10,000 calls, and $120.0 for 100,000 calls. The model's knowledge cutoff is December 2023, ensuring it has a broad and up-to-date understanding of the world.

### Use Cases and Competitors
The Xiaomi: MiMo-V2-Omni model excels in various use cases, including chat, text generation, coding, analysis, and summarization, thanks to its capabilities such as text, function calling, JSON mode, streaming, and structured outputs. While there are no direct competitors listed for this model, its unique combination of features and pricing makes it an attractive option for developers seeking a robust and versatile language model.
